latest.headline: Huang is out at Nvidia; MU steadies near $800 before PPI
latest.tldr: Nvidia's CEO resigned Thursday and chips absorbed it (MU closed $798.44, −1.59%, after opening −5.18%), and MU's latest pre-market print is $806.07 (+0.96%) with futures slightly positive ahead of October PPI at 8:30 ET (7:30 SK).
